$comment: Bowie's own indicator settings, from the TradingView script 'Ichimoku Kinko Hyo Cloud - no offset - no repaint' by KryptoNight. See docs/SPEC.md section 3.

ichimoku.$shiftNote: Plotted shift = displacement - extraBars = 35. RESOLVED 2026-09-20 from Bowie's own chart: on 20 Sep the cloud extends to 25 Oct, which is exactly 35 bars forward, so his 'Displacement: additional bars' is 0. A shift of 34 would end the cloud on 24 Oct.
ichimoku.$senkouASourceNote: RESOLVED 2026-09-20 from the Pine source: leadingSpanA = avg(conversion, baseline) = (tenkan + kijun) / 2. The auxiliary base line is plot-only and feeds no formula.
ichimoku.$cloudModeNote: RESOLVED 2026-09-20: Bowie reads the traditional displaced cloud, projected forward. Cloud at bar t comes from senkou[t-35]. The no-offset variant is still computed and kept in the output, but does not drive the table or the score.

usage.$comment: Exactly which EMA is used on which timeframe. Cells not listed are never shown and never scored.

portfolio.$comment: Two simulated portfolios. Informational only - nothing is ever traded. See docs/SPEC.md section 11.
portfolio.$startDateNote: Bowie starts "today", 2026-09-20. The simulated purchase happens at the last CLOSED daily close available on that day, which is 2026-09-19 - candles close at 00:00 UTC, so 20 September has not closed yet. Using 2026-09-20 here would leave the portfolio empty until the next run.

strategy.$weightNote: Top-10 coins share at least 50% (up to 100%) pro rata by market cap. Coins ranked 11+ are split evenly at no more than 5% each, so they never exceed 50% in total. Whatever cannot be allocated stays in stablecoins - up to 100% when nothing qualifies.
strategy.$altcoinGateNote: RESOLVED 2026-09-20: Kijun, not Tenkan. An altcoin must be above its daily Kijun-35 in USD AND above the Kijun-35 of its {coin}/BTC series. Same line as the report's preferBtc flag, so table and portfolio never disagree.
